description: After the user asks to save an illustration, attach transferable image bytes to an EXISTING food_id as Visual reference, not a photo of the actual meal. Private; preserves actual photos and meal time. Requires request_id and confirmed=true. ChatGPT must pass image via its file bridge; a rendered image or local file ID alone cannot be attached. Only attached=true with verified stored bytes/readback confirms persistence. Retry the SAME request_id after uncertainty; never log another meal. ($0.15; API key required)

confirmed.description: true only after the user requested saving this image to this meal.

food_id.description: Existing Food Diary food_id from log_food or find_image_target. Never create a duplicate meal to attach an image.

image.description: ChatGPT chat attachment. Prefer this for images from the conversation; API clients may still use image_base64 or url.

image_base64.description: Actual image bytes, for clients without the ChatGPT file bridge.

url.description: HTTPS image URL for expert API clients only; SSRF checks apply.
